He knelt, staring out at the dark rolling sea, and knew he would carry that note with him for every watch to come.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还裹着夜的薄纱，街道上只有零星晚归人拖着长长的影子走过，路灯把光揉成暖黄的一团，落在空无一人的斑马线上。远处的楼宇大多沉在暗里，只有几扇窗还亮着微光，像散落在黑绒上的碎星。风掠过树梢，带着一点初秋的凉意，卷着路边早点摊刚生起的煤烟味飘远，连平时喧闹的十字路口都静得能听见落叶擦过地面的轻响。", "w03": "- Recursion is when you solve a big problem by breaking it into smaller copies of the same problem until the tiny, easiest version is obvious to solve.\n- For example, if you want to find your way out of a maze, you follow each path a little ways, and if you hit a dead end, you backtrack and try the next turn, repeating until you find the exit.\n- Once you reach the easiest fixed point (like the end of a line, or the maze exit), you pass the answer back up to every earlier step until you have the solution to the original big problem."}
